# truenas_iscsi_global_config (Resource)

`alua` is a no-op for FreeNAS.

This resource manages existing settings: creating it applies the configured attributes, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alua` (Boolean) Whether Asymmetric Logical Unit Access (ALUA) is enabled. Enabling is limited to TrueNAS Enterprise-licensed     high availability systems. ALUA only works when configured on both the client and server.
- `basename` (String) Base name prefix for iSCSI target IQNs.
- `iser` (Boolean) Whether iSCSI Extensions for RDMA (iSER) are enabled. Enabling is limited to TrueNAS Enterprise-licensed     systems and requires the system and network environment have Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA)-capable hardware.
- `isns_servers` (List of String) Array of iSNS (Internet Storage Name Service) server addresses.
- `listen_port` (Number) TCP port number for iSCSI connections.
- `pool_avail_threshold` (Number) Pool available space threshold percentage or `null` to disable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_iscsi_global_config.this
  provider = truenas
  id       = "iscsi_global"
}
```
